title: AI Design Pain Observatory — 2026 seed taxonomy
methodNote: This seed consolidates researched community pain themes. A reported experience is a signal, not proof of prevalence or causation. Each future record should link to evidence records with explicit strength.

signals.summary: Outputs repeatedly converge on familiar card, gradient, glow, pill, hero and dashboard grammars.
Generation begins before audience, job, goal and consequence are resolved.
Repeated generation drifts toward model defaults and weakens coherent identity.
Agents fabricate tokens, clone components, mutate variants and use stale APIs.
Design, code, tokens, docs and prompts become competing authorities.
Polished defaults hide missing states, long-content failures and extreme-data fragility.
English defaults and automated scans are mistaken for localization and accessibility evidence.
Responsive work is reduced to a few widths rather than content, input and preference adaptation.
Small requested changes trigger unrelated redesign or behavior changes.
Prompt loops spend time, tokens and credits repairing generated mistakes.
Screenshot polish obscures runtime, performance, SEO, security and maintainability gaps.
Plausible explanations and invented assumptions obscure what was actually known and decided.
An attractive first output discourages materially different concepts and research.
Surface polish makes design omissions harder for non-designers to recognize or prompt for.
